scripts.text:
[Amachang]
Welcome to Amatsu,
the town of kind towners
and beautiful cherry blossoms.
scripts.translation:
[阿瑪暢]
歡迎來到櫻花城，這裡有親切的居民，還有美麗的櫻花。

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
I'm Amachang,
the 13th Miss Amatsu.
I will guide you about town
as Miss Amatsu.
Please tell me
if you want to know something.
scripts.translation:
[阿瑪暢]
我是阿瑪暢，第13屆櫻花城小姐。
身為櫻花城小姐，我會為您介紹這座城鎮。
有什麼想了解的，儘管告訴我。

scripts.text: Palace
scripts.translation: 宮殿

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 道具店

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Bar
scripts.translation: 酒吧

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
On the mini-map,
go to ^FF3355+^000000
to find the Palace.
Have a good time
in Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[阿瑪暢]
沿著小地圖上^FF3355+^000000標記的方向走，就能找到宮殿。
祝您在櫻花城玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Guide Man]
Welcome, tourist from Midgard.
I'm the guide of
our beautiful town, Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
歡迎您，來自米德加爾特的遊客。
我是這座美麗城鎮——櫻花城的嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Guide Man]
What are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
您在找什麼？
